item.title: Everywhere 1.5.0
item.description: Copy a file or folder path (for example with Finder's Copy as Pathname) and press the shortcut: Everywhere opens already searching for it.

item.title: Everywhere 1.4.1
item.description: Audio and video in the preview now stop playing when you press Esc or switch to another app.

item.title: Everywhere 1.4.0
item.description: Nuevo: al seleccionar un archivo ves su vista previa y su información (tipo, tamaño, dimensiones de las imágenes, ubicación y fechas) en un panel a la derecha; ⇧⌘P lo muestra u oculta. La ventana es más grande para que quepa todo. Esc ahora cierra la ventana y conserva la búsqueda para la próxima vez.

item.title: Everywhere 1.3.1
item.description: The update window is now always in English.

item.title: Everywhere 1.3.0
item.description: Everywhere now lives in the menu bar: it no longer takes a spot in the Dock or leaves windows open. Open it with the shortcut (⌥Space by default) or from the menu bar icon; it hides by itself when you switch apps. At login it starts in the background, and Settings no longer opens on its own.

item.title: Everywhere 1.2.0
item.description: New: your search terms appear in bold; ↑ brings back recent searches; quick filters (Audio, Video, Images, Documents, Archives, Apps, Folders) with ⌃1…⌃7; a column and search by creation date (dc:); Kind and Extension columns (right-click the header); Open With, Open in Terminal, Rename (F2) and Copy Folder Path; a floating Spotlight-style window in Settings. Safer: it asks before opening many files or moving more than 10 to the Trash, and ⌘Z undoes moves to the Trash and renames. The index is rebuilt once after updating.

item.title: Everywhere 1.1.0
item.description: New: choose any shortcut to open Everywhere in Settings › General (⌥Space by default); it also shows in the menu bar menu. Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive (~/Library/CloudStorage) are left out of the index by default because every listing goes over the network; you can include them in Settings › Exclude.

item.title: Everywhere 1.0.2
item.description: Everywhere now correctly detects Full Disk Access on macOS 27: once it's turned on, the welcome screen shows the green check mark and the index includes protected folders.

item.title: Everywhere 1.0.1
item.description: Everywhere now appears in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access so you can turn it on, and the welcome screen explains how to add it if it's missing.

item.title: Everywhere 1.0.0
item.description: First version: find any file by name instantly, with a live index, Everything-style search syntax, the global ⌥Space shortcut and Quick Look.
